b1rdmania-claude-premortem-skill-root.description: Run a premortem on any plan, launch, product, hire, strategy, or decision. Imagines it failed 6 months from now, works backward to find every reason why, then produces a revised plan. Triggers include "premortem this", "premortem my", "what could kill this", "stress test this plan", "find the blind spots", "poke holes in this", "where will this break", "am I missing anything", "what could go wrong", "future-proof this", "devil's advocate this".
